title_zh: 三处重点区运行与审计升级包
title_en: Three Key Areas Operating and Audit Upgrade Pack
authority_boundary: No confirmed parcel, roster, service hour, construction action, operating authorisation or official spatial control is asserted.

shared_gates.condition_zh: 角色、报酬、数据与停用条件书面确认
shared_gates.condition_en: roles, compensation, data boundary and pause conditions agreed in writing

shared_gates.condition_zh: 范围、责任、消防、无障碍、设备隔离与撤场条件通过
shared_gates.condition_en: scope, duty, fire, accessibility, isolation and removal conditions pass

shared_gates.condition_zh: 仅在已核验的时段运行；不接生产系统
shared_gates.condition_en: operate only in verified windows; no production-system connection

shared_gates.condition_zh: 审看可达、劳动、隐私、申诉与停用记录
shared_gates.condition_en: review access, labor, privacy, appeal and pause records

shared_gates.condition_zh: 根据证据决定，不以招商、客流或效率替代审计
shared_gates.condition_en: decide from evidence, not investment, footfall or efficiency claims

audit_dimensions.evidence_zh: 人工入口、无扫码服务、连续无障碍路线
audit_dimensions.evidence_en: staffed threshold, no-scan service, continuous accessible route

audit_dimensions.evidence_zh: 人工升级可用、问题有处理责任与复核路径
audit_dimensions.evidence_en: staffed escalation works; issues have duty and review path

audit_dimensions.evidence_zh: 只保留必要去标识事件；不记录绩效、情绪、轨迹或生产工单
audit_dimensions.evidence_en: necessary de-identified events only; no performance, emotion, traces or production tickets

audit_dimensions.evidence_zh: 付费参与、设备隔离、当班责任、可撤场
audit_dimensions.evidence_en: paid participation, equipment isolation, on-duty responsibility and removability

audit_dimensions.title_zh: 公共连续性与公开复盘
audit_dimensions.evidence_zh: 时段、停用、修复与月度摘要可解释
audit_dimensions.evidence_en: time windows, pauses, repairs and monthly summary are explainable

pause_conditions.title_zh: 无障碍路线阻断且未修复
情绪识别、身份推断或隐蔽追踪
pause_conditions.title_en: emotion recognition, identity inference or covert tracking

pause_conditions.title_zh: 接入生产系统或生产性工单
设备、用电、消防或人身安全条件不通过
pause_conditions.title_en: equipment, power, fire or personal-safety condition fails

pause_conditions.title_zh: 责任角色、申诉路径或撤场预案缺失
pause_conditions.title_en: duty role, appeal route or removal plan missing

areas.operating_focus_zh: 研发—维护—带薪学习在公共首层交班
areas.operating_focus_en: R&D, maintenance and paid learning share a public ground floor
areas.reversible_session_zh: 非生产性维护演示、带薪学习、人工交接
areas.reversible_session_en: non-production maintenance demo, paid learning and staffed handover
areas.audit_evidence_zh: 授权范围、设备隔离、人工升级、去标识服务记录
areas.audit_evidence_en: authorisation, equipment isolation, staffed escalation and de-identified service records
areas.hold_condition_zh: 未完成设备/用电隔离或人工入口失效
areas.hold_condition_en: equipment/power isolation incomplete or staffed access unavailable

areas.operating_focus_zh: 学习—照护—人工服务在多模态导视下交接
areas.operating_focus_en: learning, care and staffed service connect through multimodal guidance
areas.reversible_session_zh: 无扫码服务演练、照护转接、无障碍导视核验
areas.reversible_session_en: no-scan service drill, care handover and accessible-wayfinding check
areas.audit_evidence_zh: 连续路线、人工响应、申诉闭环、低刺激恢复空间可达
areas.audit_evidence_en: continuous route, staffed response, appeal closure and quiet recovery access
areas.hold_condition_zh: 无障碍路线中断、人工服务或申诉入口缺失
areas.hold_condition_en: accessible route blocked, or staffed service/appeal route unavailable

areas.operating_focus_zh: 换乘—配送—小店服务—夜间安全离开分流协同
areas.operating_focus_en: transfer, delivery, small-business service and safe night departure are separated and coordinated
areas.reversible_session_zh: 遮雨交接、短停补给、小店数据边界与人工求助演练
areas.reversible_session_en: sheltered handover, short-rest supply, shop-data boundary and staffed-help drill
areas.audit_evidence_zh: 人车分流、无追踪导向、夜间照明检查、应急转介
areas.audit_evidence_en: flow separation, non-tracking guidance, night-lighting check and emergency referral
areas.hold_condition_zh: 步行/配送冲突无法缓解，或出现个人路线追踪
areas.hold_condition_en: walking/delivery conflict cannot be mitigated, or individual route tracking appears

known_limits: All key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints, not official redlines or precise-area bases.
No pilot may recruit, install, open, collect personal data or connect to production systems without paid co-design and G1 verification.
Metrics are governance counts for the working pack, not performance targets or implementation commitments.
